summary: scripts/install-git-hooks (run by nix develop) adds the negative refspec ^refs/tags/evidence/* to the origin remote once per clone, so `git fetch --tags` no longer pulls tens of thousands of evidence record tags and the pull request commits they reach. The README's pre-signing section says to clone with --no-tags.

schema.detail: No schema or persistent data changes.

rules.detail: No gate or verifier change; a fetch that names the evidence refs still gets them.

compatibility.detail: Only the local clone's fetch configuration changes; CI already passes the same negative refspec.

manual.detail: Existing clones get the refspec the next time nix develop runs scripts/install-git-hooks; evidence tags already fetched stay until deleted (git tag -l 'evidence/*' | xargs git tag -d).

recovery.detail: scripts/install-git-hooks --uninstall removes the refspec, or revert the change.
